slides.title: What Hiring Managers Actually Look For
slides.subtitle: It's not just your cert list

bullets: Show evidence - a lab, a blog, a GitHub
Explain risk in plain English, not jargon
Talk about what you broke and fixed
Know why you want their specific industry

caption: Most cyber candidates look identical on paper. The ones who get hired show their thinking - not just their cert list. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #infosec #cypherjobs #jobsearch
